name: Usami Mimi
source: A kindhearted and sweet high school girl at Usagino high school who most exemplifies the demure ideal Shinuske is looking for. As a young girl Mimi found a group of abandoned rabbits and helped raise them with her friends. The experience gave her a great love of bunnies. She is the first to join the bunny club and the first to wear a bunny suit for Shinuske. She becomes the standard by which all the other girls are judged.
